svg.title: FreqOff leftover
svg.desc: Case sketch for this worked example.
svg.text: If you created the program in SD but FreqOff is still on, X ; Y DT is Syntax ERROR.
The first statement FreqOn in the listing forces frequency on each run
If you still see Syntax ERROR, enter SD with MODE 4, SHIFT MODE ◀ ◀ 1, then run again
